titles.romaji: Ultra Nyan: Hoshizora kara Maiorita Fushigi Neko
titles.native: ウルトラニャン　星空から舞い降りたふしぎネコ

description: Haruka finds a cat in an abandoned building and names it "Nyan".  Little does she know that this cat is actually "Ultra-Nyan" who has come from outer space.  Using his mysterious powers, Ultra-Nyan helps Haruka and her friends foil the plans of a couple of no-good catnappers.
